title: A filter argument on one column leaves the filter on another table's column in place

source.quote: If the columns or tables aren't in the filter context, new filters are added to the filter context to evaluate the expression.
source.supports: a filter on a column not yet in the filter context is added to it

source.quote: Filters on columns other than those mentioned in the arguments of CALCULATE or other related functions remain in effect and unaltered.
source.supports: filters on columns other than the argument's stay in effect

notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
